conflicts: INCI divergence DE vs US: the US manufacturer page (ogxbeauty.com, 13 fl oz / 25.4 fl oz sizes, no GTIN) lists a shorter 17-item formula without Sodium Chloride, Sodium Lactate, Lactic acid, Urea, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate, Coconut Acid, Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate, Lecithin, Benzoic Acid, Tocopherol and Ascorbyl Palmitate (DE retailers list 28 items). Different market formula; the US page is not the German 385 ml pack.

Claim vs INCI: Rossmann claims 'ohne Silikone' but the INCI contains Amodimethicone (a silicone, listed #10). Amodimethicone is also listed in the US INCI. Retailer claim only; the OGX US page does not claim 'silicone-free'.

Claim vs INCI: dm.de ('Mit ... Weizenprotein') and Rossmann ('hydrolysiertem Weizenprotein') claim wheat protein, but no hydrolyzed wheat protein appears in any INCI (collagen and a potato-starch derivative are the only protein/starch items).
Wording: 'ohne sulfathaltige Tenside' is consistent with the INCI (taurate/glucoside/betaine surfactants; no sulfate).
canonicalReason: Three independent German GTIN-anchored retailers (dm.de page GTIN, Rossmann GTIN URL, Müller structured-data GTIN) agree item-for-item and in order (Rossmann has a typographic space in 'Parfum/ Fragrance'). The US manufacturer page is a different market formula and is preserved as a conflict, not selected. No German manufacturer page or pack photo exists to this worker, hence tier 3.
normalization: Split the canonical raw INCI on ',' (not on commas inside locants such as '1,2-'), merged split synonym entries such as 'Aqua (Water)' / 'Aqua/Water/Eau' into one item each; per ingredient: lower-case, trim, collapse internal whitespace, remove whitespace around '/'; drop a trailing period and any leading label such as 'Inhaltsstoffe:'; keep parentheses, asterisks and hyphens as published; join the normalized ingredients with '|' and sha256 the UTF-8 string.
notes: Prior v1.3/v1.4 capture used the same dm/Rossmann/Müller list (fingerprint b1c71405cd2bfc449d8a138c11c947dfd135a8cfcc63cb4920649af4b3ad4471, comma-joined); German list unchanged.

Status frozen_with_conflict because (a) the manufacturer's own US page diverges and (b) retailer claims contradict the INCI (silicone-free vs Amodimethicone; wheat protein absent). The German canonical list itself is unambiguous (3/3 agree).
